descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S01 OAT-04 steps 1-2 as written (Hospital): seven aged items each deleted at its window, queryable as gone

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 Hospital pre-round text clears at 12 h: pre-round text seeded at 13 h is deleted. (UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: pre-round text 12 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U3 Hospital Important Points clear at 12 h: an Important Point seeded at 13 h is deleted. (UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: Important Points 12 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Hospital held and stopped medication rows are deleted at 36 h, and a held row's clock restarts each time the chart is processed: a held row not refreshed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: held/stopped med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U8 Handoffs are deleted 36 h after they were sent: a handoff sent 37 h ago is gone from the database, for sender and recipient alike. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: handoffs 36 h after sent)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician with two synthetic Hospital patients and one colleague account. Through the aging helper, on patient A: pre-round text processed 13 h ago, an Important Point written 13 h ago, a vital and a lab last refreshed 37 h ago, an active medication row last mentioned 37 h ago, a held medication ro …

When The purge runs (the server job; on main only rounding:applyLifecycle exists), then the raw documents are read with admin access

Then Each of the seven aged items on patient A is absent from the database (field or row gone, no flag holding the value); the 37 h handoff's text and patient content are gone (what may remain is Q20); every control item on patient B, a 1 h handoff and both roster entries are untouched

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per item, from UAT OAT-04 step 2 / Expected 1 and TFA-94699 AC 1: absent from the raw document or table = pass for that item; present in any form (including a hidden or flagged copy) = Fail; a control item missing = Fail (deleted too early). Handoff: its text and every patient's content in it absent = pass; …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

13 h after it was written an Important Point is still on the chart, a 37 h-old open task is still in the task list, and a handoff sent 37 h ago is still fully readable by sender and recipient.

Evidence: allure 9ce53c58-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/retention. 14 checks pass, 3 fail, all known: K1 (points clear at 18 h on one clock), K2 (open tasks never purged), K3 (handoffs never purged). Q20 (what of a handoff may remain) is recorded only. The ticket in progress, TFA-94699, covers exactly these windows.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S01

OAT-04 steps 1-2 as written (Hospital): seven aged items each deleted at its window, queryable as gone

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: yes): API spec: fresh physician + fresh colleague; patient A split in two charts so every 'given' holds at once (A-short: pre-round processed 13 h, point 13 h; A-long: vital + lab + active row + held row + open task with chart last processed 37 h); control B with every item 1 h old; handoff 37 h and control handoff 1 h (sentAt set by the helper). Purge, then raw rows by admin read; handoff judged on text/patient content per Q20. — All items can be written through the app's own mutations and aged by the helper; the purge is the app's own function.

Where it ran: local

Detail:

14 judged items passed, 3 failed (3 known, 0 policy conflict, 0 not in the matrix knownGaps), 1 recorded against open questions — failed: A.point (Important Point written 13 h ago: expected absent, got present; known K1) | A.openTask (open task 'Recheck BMP' on a chart last processed 37 h ago: expected absent, got present; known K2) | handoff37.content (handoff sent 37 h ago: its text and patient content (sender and recipient): expected absent, got present (row still there with fields _creationTime, _id, fromUserId, patientCount, readAt, sentAt, text, title, toUserId, variant); known K3) — record-only: handoff37.stub = full row: _creationTime, _id, fromUserId, patientCount, readAt, sentAt, text, title, toUserId, variant [Q20 (TC-08 'persistent record' vs OAT-04 (B) delete)]

Product issue: 13 h after it was written an Important Point is still on the chart, a 37 h-old open task ('Recheck BMP') is still in the task list, and a handoff sent 37 h ago is still readable in full by sender and recipient. Breaks OAT-04 step 2 / Expected 1 and UAT 3.6 (points 12 h, open tasks and handoffs 36 h). Known in the matrix: K1, K2, K3.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation that moves a chart's stamps back, called with the local stack's admin key) and the retention-db runner, which seeds through e2e/support/backend.ts and reads the raw rows with adminQuery; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls only the l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
